post.full_post:
Ever feel like you're juggling a million things and still not hitting your flow? 🌪️

I've been diving deep into my latest project, Momina, and it's been a wild ride of learning and iterating. The goal was simple: create something that actually solves a real problem without the usual complexity. It hasn't always been smooth sailing—there were definitely a few 'back to the drawing board' moments—but seeing it all come together is the best feeling. I'm finally at a stage where I can share the progress and I'd love to get some fresh eyes on it!

I'd love to hear your thoughts! Drop a comment or DM me to see what I've been building. 👇
